caribbean.headline: St. Maarten Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds
caribbean.paragraph: St. Maarten is experiencing 100% rain probability, sustained winds up to 22 kt, and waves reaching 5.2 ft. Nassau is experiencing 21 kt winds and rain.

mediterranean.headline: Venice Endures 100% Rain, Calm Winds
mediterranean.paragraph: Venice is experiencing calm winds of 0 kt, waves up to 2.6 ft, and a 100% rain probability. Istanbul sees moderate breezes of 12 kt, waves staying under 3 ft.
